integrations.name: Razorpay Payment Gateway
integrations.purpose: Order creation, card/UPI/netbanking payment collection, webhook verification, and automated refunds
integrations.current_mechanism: Direct new Razorpay\Api\Api(key, secret) in PaymentService constructor
failure_modes: Invalid signature during client return/webhook verification
Duplicate webhook delivery for already paid booking
integrations.retry_behavior: Idempotent retry for pending orders; duplicate verify rejected with 422
integrations.test_strategy: Offline HMAC-SHA256 signature calculation, container mocking of gateway adapter

integrations.name: Google OAuth Token Verification
integrations.purpose: Decodes and validates Google JWT ID token to authenticate/register users
integrations.test_strategy: Http::fake() with deterministic Google user payload

integrations.name: ExchangeRate-API
integrations.purpose: Fetches current currency exchange rates against INR for multi-currency display
integrations.retry_behavior: Automatic fallback to cached rates (12h TTL) and hardcoded baseline rates array
integrations.test_strategy: Unit tests using deterministic baseline rates and cache mocking

integrations.name: Media Storage & Image Processing
integrations.purpose: Saves uploaded creatives and thumbnails, executes WebP compression and dimension validation
integrations.current_sdk: PHP GD extension (imagecreatefromjpeg, imagewebp) and Storage facade
integrations.current_mechanism: Direct low-level GD functions and storage_path('app/public')
failure_modes: Out of memory during large image resize
integrations.retry_behavior: Fail upload request cleanly with descriptive 422 error

integrations.name: SMTP Mailer
integrations.purpose: Dispatches transactional notifications (booking confirmation, provider invitation, payment receipt, status updates)
integrations.current_mechanism: 28 Mailables in app/Mail/ called synchronously or via sync queue
integrations.retry_behavior: Logged in notification_logs table with status='failed'
